name: CSS Covenant
note: R13.10, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.37 (PDF p.38). The Light Cruiser converted to a carrier, and close enough to it that the differences are the useful part of this note. IDENTICAL to the CL: shields 30/24/20/20/20/24 counted box by box, F hull 4, rear hull 8, warp 12 a side, impulse 4, bridge 2, emergency 2, aux 2, transporters 4, tractors 4, labs 4, one probe launcher, turn mode C, command rating 6, and every damage track - damcon 4-2-2-2-0, sensor 6-6-5-3-1-0, scanner 0-0-1-3-5-9, excess 5. WHAT THE CONVERSION COST: one battery and one APR, THREE each here against the CL's four, both counted at 500 dpi because a carrier trading power for bay space is exactly the sort of difference that gets copied over by eye. CREW GOES THE OTHER WAY: 40 crew against the CL's 36, 10 boarding parties against 12, and NINE DECK CREWS for its nine fighters. Its plasma is PLASMA-S from the hull rather than from a refit, and its phaser-3s are base armament, both because YS:171 is after the Y170 PL-S and Y165 PH-3 refit dates - the same reasoning as the Strike Cruiser. Point value 135 on the sheet with 'WITHOUT PL-F REFIT (PRE Y179) = -8', so 127 is the Y171 hull. The four rear-firing plasma-F are R13.1C's, flagged iscRearFiring, and arrive with the PL-F refit exactly as the CL's do. THE BAY: twelve SHUTTLE boxes in a 3x4 block, three plain and nine marked, which resolves as three administrative shuttles and nine fighter positions - the administrative shuttles table lists exactly three, and the complement the owner gave is 5 superiority, 3 assault and 1 EW, which is nine. Two balcony positions (J1.53) as on the CL. ITS EW FIGHTER WILL BE AN FEF, NOT THE FEK THE SHEET DRAWS. The fighter roster in data/shuttles/isc.json is deliberately simplified and carries no FEK, so the isc-fighter line resolves ew to FEF. The owner chose that 2026-10-23; it is not a misreading of the sheet, and adding FEK would fix it whenever the fidelity is wanted. The Y180 Sabot refit (+10.25) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope, and a quarter point would not fit an integer bpv.

refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE ALL PLASMA-F TORPEDOES. Four here, two a side, the same count and the same arcs as the Light Cruiser's. R13.1C's rear-firing torpedoes, flagged iscRearFiring - see the Star Cruiser's note for what that anchors. The sheet's pseudo-plasma box lists S-type pseudos for A and B and none for these, which is R13.1C's 'no PPTs' drawn rather than written.
